title: Mediated Studies In Respiratory Therapy I
description: First of seven courses paralleling content taught in courses in the Respiratory Therapy Program. Designed to develop and reinforce concepts taught in the concurrent lecture and laboratory sessions of the program, with a focus on hand hygiene, PPE, oxygen equipment, communication, electronic health records, patient history, teamwork, time management, patient positioning, and ethics. Media materials, simulations, and videos will provide alternative learning resources to accommodate diverse learning styles. Intended for students in the Respiratory Therapy Program; enrollment is limited to students accepted in the program.
outcomes: Support concurrent lecture and laboratory sessions through an alternative learning resource. Students will be able to explain key aspects of Pulmonary Anatomy and Physiology and Infection.
To relate and strengthen concepts through media, topics include oxygen therapy and vital signs
objectives: Identify personal protective equipment (PPE) and demonstrate how and when to use PPE.
Identify the different types of oxygen therapy equipment.
Demonstrate how to navigate through electronic health records (EHR).
Demonstrate how to look up a patient's history.
Describe the role of ethics in health care.
Demonstrate how to position patients properly.
